facts.business: Ramky Infrastructure Limited is an infrastructure development and project execution company operating through Construction and Developer businesses across industrial parks, water & wastewater, and urban infrastructure sectors.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis on Note 48 regarding write-off of receivables

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgement and estimation in construction contracts
Write-off of receivables amounting to significant value
Dependence on survey of work performed for revenue recognition
Changes in scope and consequential revised contract prices
Identification of contractual obligations and rights to receive payments
facts.related_party_note: Significant related party borrowings: Secured borrowings from related parties ₹1,759.37 million (nil interest), unsecured borrowings from related parties ₹400 million at 8% interest, and various subsidiary borrowings from related parties at 8-11% interest
